description.narrative: El objetivo general es mejorar el acceso y la graduacin de la Educacin Superior (ES) en Colombia. Los objetivos especficos (OE) son: (i) incrementar el trnsito desde Educacin MEdia (EM) a Educacin Superior (ES) de jvenes de zonas focalizadas; (ii) mejorar la permanencia de los estudiantes de ES; y (iii) fortalecer la gestin de la calidad de la oferta educativa de la ES.

The general objective is to improve access and graduation from Higher Education (HE) in Colombia. The specific objectives (OE) are: (i) increase the transit from Secondary Education (EM) to Higher Education (ES) of young people from targeted areas; (ii) improve the permanence of HE students; and (iii) strengthen the quality management of the HE educational offer.
